stubs: query.size supplies old requested owner dimensions; not original size/cache provider
query.resize and MoveWidget record calls only; do not execute original downstream geometry/events
transformTextWithVerticalAlignment invokes callback directly; original text-style cache omitted

fixtureStyle: Shipped axure_rp_page.css plus independently constructed owner/text CSS and Arial 13px body. Synthetic structures are not claimed compiler output.

hidden owner clones are removed

no-op still registers

plain CRLF and LF split; bare CR remains in text
plain separator characters are retained without BR rewriting
ordinary spaces are not rewritten to NBSP
trailing BR has no extra terminal strut
first paragraph and first span style/id survive replacement
plain setter treats HTML-like input as text
empty hidden text retains effective padding only
height measured before width
